note: Judge or human evaluates output quality. Not run in default CI.

cases.query: 用xc881写作 BrowserWindow 创建流程
checklist: conclusion has 3 to 5 bullets, each backed by a path or function anchor
call order is evidence-backed, not presented as guessed fact
specialized concepts are grounded before later sections rely on them
common programming concepts are not over-explained

cases.query: 用xc881写作，分析 tokio 这个 Rust runtime 的任务调度入口
checklist: evidence categories are instantiated for the target stack (crate/module/build), not forced into Chromium terms like GN target
entry and call-chain claims carry a derivation path, not a bare assertion
each claim is either backed by debugger/runtime output or explicitly marked as static inference with its static basis
possibly-stale API or version facts are cited from official docs, not asserted from memory

cases.query: 先读仓库里的 BrowserWindow 实现，再按我的风格写源码文章
checklist: simple exact/local/low-risk evidence may be read directly while complex/tracked source inspection is delegated to Coding
Coding returns bounded path/function/call-chain evidence without taking article ownership
the article skill resumes from evidence and owns prose structure and style
provided evidence is not redundantly reread

cases.query: 把现有源码证据整理成一篇函数级文章，不再读仓库
checklist: Source remains the only active owner and reuses the supplied evidence
does not invoke Coding merely because the article discusses code
does not run ecosystem recon when the supplied evidence already identifies the stack
uses bounded Solution research only if one external term fact blocks a reliable claim

cases.query: 源码文章委派 Coding 读调用链时发生自动上下文压缩
checklist: preserves article ownership, active section and prose style across context compaction
resumes the bounded Coding evidence request without expanding into unrelated code
returns path/function/call-chain evidence to the same article run
continues writing automatically without asking the user to re-invoke a skill
